liveClass.title: Ricam var

lessons.title: Acaba ... mümkün mü?
lessons.goal: I was wondering if, Would you mind ve Would it be possible gibi yapılarla kibar ricalarda bulunabilirim.

lines.speaker: Aslı
lines.text: Sorry to bother you, Mr Demir. Have you got a minute?

lines.speaker: Aslı
lines.text: I was wondering if I could work from home on Fridays. My commute takes nearly two hours.

lines.text: Hmm. I'll need to think about it. Would you mind sending me a short proposal?

learn.explanation:
Bir şeyi ne kadar **dolaylı** isterseniz o kadar **kibar** olursunuz.

| Kibarlık | Yapı |
|---|---|
| Doğrudan | **Can** I work from home? |
| Kibar | **Could** I work from home? |
| Daha kibar | **Would it be possible** (for me) **to** work from home? |
| Daha kibar | **Do you think I could** work from home? |
| Çok kibar | **I was wondering if** I could work from home. |

**Would you mind ...?**

| Yapı | Anlam |
|---|---|
| **Would you mind** + **-ing**? | Sizin bir şey yapmanızı rica ederim. |
| *Would you mind **sending** me the file?* | Dosyayı gönderir misiniz? |
| **Would you mind if I** + past? | Ben bir şey yapabilir miyim? |
| *Would you mind **if I opened** the window?* | Pencereyi açmamın sakıncası var mı? |

**Dikkat:** "Would you mind" sorusunu **kabul ederken "No"** denir, çünkü soru "sakıncası var mı?" demektir:

- *Would you mind waiting?* → **Not at all.** / **No, of course not.** (Hayır, sakıncası yok = tamam.)

**Ricaya giriş:** *Sorry to bother you, but ...* / *I hope you don't mind me asking, but ...*

examples.en: I was wondering if you could help me with this report.
examples.tr: Acaba bu raporda bana yardım edebilir misiniz diye düşünüyordum.

examples.en: Would you mind closing the door?
Would it be possible to change my appointment?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede kibarlık genellikle "-ebilir misiniz", "rica etsem", "acaba" gibi kelimelerle sağlanır. İngilizcede "I was wondering if" Türkçedeki "acaba"ya çok yakındır. Türkçe konuşanların en sık hatası "Would you mind" sorusuna "Yes" diyerek kabul etmektir: "Yes" aslında "Evet, sakıncası var" anlamına gelir! Ayrıca "Would you mind to send" yanlıştır; "mind" -ing alır.

options: I was wondering if you could help me.

lessons.title: Yumuşatarak söylemek
lessons.goal: Olumsuz haberleri ve eleştirileri yumuşatma teknikleriyle diplomatik bir şekilde iletebilirim.

discover.title: Bir müşteriye yanıt: iki versiyon
discover.body:
Version A:
"Your order is late. We can't deliver it this week. There is a problem with our supplier. You have to wait until next month."

Version B:
"I'm afraid there has been a slight delay with your order. Unfortunately, we won't be able to deliver it this week, as there seems to be a small problem with our supplier. We were hoping to send it by Friday, but it looks as though it may not arrive until early next month. We do apologise for any inconvenience."

questions.prompt: When will the order probably arrive?
questions.explanation: "may not arrive until early next month"

learn.explanation:
Kötü haber verirken, eleştiri yaparken ya da hayır derken **yumuşatma** (softening) teknikleri kullanılır.

| Teknik | Doğrudan | Yumuşatılmış |
|---|---|---|
| **I'm afraid / Unfortunately** | It's late. | **I'm afraid** it's a little late. |
| **Küçültücüler:** slight, a bit, a little, small | There's a problem. | There's **a slight** problem. |
| **seem / appear** | You made a mistake. | There **seems to be** a mistake. |
| **Geçmiş zamanla mesafe** | We hope to send it. | We **were hoping** to send it. |
| **Olumsuz + olumlu sıfat** | It's bad. | It's **not ideal**. / It's **not very** good. |
| **Modal'larla belirsizlik** | It won't arrive. | It **may not** arrive. |
| **Kişisizleştirme (passive)** | You didn't pay. | The payment **hasn't been received**. |

**Geçmiş zamanla mesafe:** Şu an için konuşsanız bile geçmiş (sürekli) zaman ricayı daha az ısrarcı yapar:

- *I **wanted** to ask you something.*
- *We **were wondering** if you could ...*
- *I **was hoping** you might help.*

**Olumsuz durumu kabul etme:** *We do apologise for any inconvenience.* (**do** vurgu için)

examples.en: I'm afraid we won't be able to attend the meeting.
There seems to be a small mistake in the invoice.
examples.tr: Faturada küçük bir hata var gibi görünüyor.

examples.en: Your idea isn't bad, but it might not be ideal for this project.
examples.tr: Fikriniz kötü değil, ama bu proje için ideal olmayabilir.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede yumuşatma için "maalesef", "biraz", "galiba", "-ebilir" gibi kelimeler kullanılır; İngilizcede de benzer araçlar var, ama iş dünyasında çok daha sistematik kullanılır. Türkçeden doğrudan çevrilen "You did this wrong" gibi cümleler İngilizcede çok kaba algılanabilir. "There seems to be a mistake" gibi kişisizleştirilmiş yapılar suçlamadan sorunu belirtmenin en iyi yoludur.

lessons.title: Resmî mi, samimi mi?
lessons.goal: Aynı mesajı resmî ve samimi üslupta ifade edebilir ve bağlama uygun kelimeyi seçebilirim.

discover.title: Aynı mesaj, iki üslup
discover.body:
Message to a friend:
"Hi Burcu! Just wanted to ask about the course you told me about. How much is it, and when does it start? Can you send me the link? Thanks a lot!"

Email to a language school:
"Dear Sir or Madam,
I am writing to enquire about your advanced Spanish course. I would be grateful if you could provide information regarding the fees and start dates. In addition, I would appreciate it if you could send me a copy of the course programme.
Thank you in advance for your assistance.
Yours faithfully,
Sevgi Çelik"

questions.prompt: What does Sevgi want to know?
questions.explanation: "information regarding the fees and start dates"

learn.explanation:
**Register (üslup):** Kime yazdığınıza göre kelime ve yapı seçimi değişir.

| Samimi | Resmî |
|---|---|
| ask about | **enquire about** |
| get | **receive / obtain** |
| need | **require** |
| help | **assist / assistance** |
| about | **regarding / concerning** |
| want | **would like / wish to** |
| give | **provide** |
| also | **in addition / furthermore** |
| but | **however** |
| sorry | **I apologise / We regret** |
| can't | **am unable to** |
| tell | **inform** |
| start / end | **commence / conclude** (çok resmî) |

**Resmî yazının diğer özellikleri:**

- **Kısaltma yok:** I'm → I am, can't → cannot
- **Edilgen yapılar daha sık:** *Your application has been received.*
- **Phrasal verb'ler yerine tek kelime:** find out → discover, put off → postpone
- **Uzun ve kibar ricalar:** *I would be grateful if you could ...* / *I would appreciate it if you could ...*

**Dikkat:** Çok resmî dili arkadaşlara kullanmak tuhaf, hatta komik durur!

examples.en: I would be grateful if you could send me further information.
examples.tr: Bana ek bilgi gönderirseniz minnettar olurum.

examples.en: We regret to inform you that the event has been cancelled.
Please do not hesitate to contact me if you require any assistance.
examples.tr: Herhangi bir yardıma ihtiyacınız olursa benimle iletişime geçmekten çekinmeyin.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede resmî yazışmada "Sayın", "arz ederim", "bilgilerinize sunarım" gibi kalıplar kullanılır. İngilizce resmî yazı daha sadedir ama kelime seçimi çok önemlidir. Türkçe konuşanlar bazen iki uç arasında kalır: ya fazla samimi ("Hi, I want info") ya da fazla süslü yazarlar. B2 seviyesinde amaç, açık, kibar ve profesyonel olmaktır.

lessons.title: İkna etmek
lessons.goal: Bir öneriyi faydalarını vurgulayarak, itirazları önceden cevaplayarak ve uzlaşma önererek ikna edici bir şekilde savunabilirim.

lines.speaker: Kerim
lines.text: I'd like to suggest that we move the team meeting from Monday morning to Tuesday afternoon.

lines.speaker: Kerim
lines.text: Well, on Monday mornings, most of us are dealing with emails from the weekend. If we met on Tuesday, everyone would be better prepared.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: But some people work from home on Tuesdays.

lines.speaker: Kerim
lines.text: That's true, but we could easily do it online. In fact, it would save time, because nobody would need to book a room.

lines.speaker: Kerim
lines.text: How about trying it for a month? If it doesn't work, we can always go back to Monday.

lines.speaker: Manager
lines.text: OK, that seems fair. Let's give it a try.

questions.prompt: Why does Kerim want to change the day?
options: People are busy with emails on Monday mornings.

questions.explanation: "How about trying it for a month?"

learn.explanation:
**İkna edici konuşmanın adımları:**

| Adım | Kalıplar |
|---|---|
| **1. Öneri** | *I'd like to suggest that we ...* / *What if we ...?* / *I think we should consider ...* |
| **2. Fayda** | *This would mean that ...* / *The main advantage is ...* / *It would save / help / allow us to ...* |
| **3. Koşul** | *If we ..., we would ...* (2nd conditional) |
| **4. İtirazı kabul edip cevaplamak** | *That's true, but ...* / *I see your point, however ...* / *I understand your concern, but ...* |
| **5. Güçlendirme** | *In fact, ...* / *It would not only save time but also ...* / *On top of that, ...* |
| **6. Uzlaşma** | *How about ...?* / *Why don't we try ...?* / *Would you be willing to ...?* / *What if we met halfway?* |

**suggest yapıları:**

- *I suggest **that we move** the meeting.* (that + özne + fiilin yalın hali)
- *I suggest **moving** the meeting.* (-ing)
- ~~I suggest to move the meeting.~~ ✗

**Retorik soru:** *Wouldn't it be better if ...?* / *Isn't it worth trying?*

examples.en: I'd like to suggest that we start a recycling programme.
examples.tr: Bir geri dönüşüm programı başlatmamızı önermek istiyorum.

examples.en: I see your point, but it would actually save us money in the long run.
examples.tr: Ne demek istediğinizi anlıyorum ama aslında uzun vadede bize para kazandırır.

examples.en: Wouldn't it be better to try it first?
examples.tr: Önce denemek daha iyi olmaz mı?

learn.turkishNote: Türkçede "önermek" fiili "-mesini önermek" yapısıyla kullanılır ve doğrudan "suggest to do" diye çevrilmeye çalışılır. Bu yanlıştır: "I suggest to go" değil, "I suggest going" ya da "I suggest that we go" deyin. İkna ederken Türkçede yaygın olan "Kesinlikle böyle yapmalıyız" gibi kesin ifadeler İngilizcede ısrarcı algılanabilir; itirazı önce kabul etmek (That's true, but...) daha ikna edicidir.

task.prompt: Okulunuzda, işyerinizde ya da mahallenizde değişmesini istediğiniz bir şeyi öneren 1–2 dakikalık ikna edici bir konuşma yapın. Öneriyi sunun, en az iki fayda söyleyin, bir itirazı önceden cevaplayın (That's true, but ...) ve sonunda bir uzlaşma önerin.
task.modelAnswer: I'd like to suggest that our office introduces flexible working hours. The main advantage is that people could avoid the rush-hour traffic, which would mean less stress and more energy. It would also help parents who need to pick up their children from school. Some people might say that it would be hard to organise meetings. That's true, but we could have core hours from ten to three, when everyone must be available. How about trying it for three months? If it doesn't work, we can always go back to the old system.

lessons.title: Resmî rica e-postası
lessons.goal: Doğru yapı, açılış-kapanış ve kibar dil kullanarak iş hayatına uygun ikna edici bir rica e-postası yazabilirim.

discover.title: Örnek e-posta: Sponsorluk ricası
discover.body:
Subject: Request for sponsorship – Children's Reading Festival

Dear Ms Aksoy,

I am writing on behalf of the Kadıköy Parents' Association to ask whether your bookshop would consider sponsoring our first Children's Reading Festival, which will take place on 14 May.

The festival aims to encourage children aged 6 to 12 to read for pleasure. We are expecting around 500 families, and the programme will include storytelling sessions, workshops with local authors and a book swap.

We would be very grateful if you could provide 100 books as prizes. In return, your bookshop's logo would appear on all our posters and on our social media pages, which have more than 8,000 followers. We would also be happy to offer you a stand at the festival.

I have attached a short description of the programme. If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Thank you for considering our request. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,

Tolga Yurt
Chair, Kadıköy Parents' Association

questions.prompt: What does the association ask for?
What does the bookshop get in return?
options: Its logo on posters and social media, and a stand
questions.explanation: "your bookshop's logo would appear... offer you a stand"

learn.explanation:
**Resmî rica e-postasının yapısı:**

| Bölüm | Kalıplar |
|---|---|
| **Konu (Subject)** | Kısa ve net: *Request for ... / Enquiry regarding ...* |
| **Hitap** | *Dear Mr / Ms + soyadı,* (ismi biliyorsanız) / *Dear Sir or Madam,* (bilmiyorsanız) |
| **Amaç** | *I am writing to request / ask whether / enquire about ...* / *I am writing on behalf of ...* |
| **Arka plan** | Kim olduğunuzu ve durumu kısaca açıklayın. |
| **Rica** | *I would be grateful if you could ...* / *I would appreciate it if you could ...* / *Would it be possible to ...?* |
| **Karşılık / fayda** | *In return, ...* / *This would allow you to ...* |
| **Ek ve iletişim** | *I have attached ... / Please find attached ...* / *If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.* |
| **Kapanış cümlesi** | *Thank you for considering my request.* / *I look forward to hearing from you.* |
| **Kapanış** | **Yours sincerely,** (ismi biliyorsanız) / **Yours faithfully,** (Dear Sir or Madam ile) / **Kind regards,** (yarı resmî) |

**Dikkat:**

- *I look forward to **hearing** from you.* (to + **-ing**; ~~to hear~~)
- **Ms** evli/bekâr ayrımı yapmayan güvenli unvandır.
- Paragraflar kısa olmalı; her paragrafta tek fikir.

examples.en: I am writing to request an extension to the deadline.
examples.tr: Son tarihin uzatılmasını talep etmek için yazıyorum.

examples.en: Please find attached the documents you requested.
I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.
examples.tr: En kısa sürede sizden haber almayı bekliyorum.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçe resmî yazışmalarda "Saygılarımla" her duruma uyar; İngilizcede ise Yours sincerely (alıcının adını biliyorsanız) ve Yours faithfully (Dear Sir or Madam ile) ayrımı vardır. En sık hata "I look forward to hear from you" demektir: buradaki "to" bir edattır ve -ing alır. Ayrıca Türkçedeki "Sayın Ahmet Bey" yapısını "Dear Mr Ahmet" diye çevirmeyin: Mr / Ms soyadıyla kullanılır (Dear Mr Yılmaz).

options: I look forward to hear from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.

task.prompt: Aşağıdaki durumlardan birini seçin ve resmî bir rica e-postası yazın (150–200 kelime): (a) Çalıştığınız şirketin müdürüne, ekibiniz için bir İngilizce kursunun ücretini karşılamasını rica edin. (b) Belediyeye, mahallenizdeki parka çocuk oyun alanı yapılmasını rica edin. Konu satırı, uygun hitap, amaç, arka plan, kibar rica, fayda / gerekçe, iletişim cümlesi ve doğru kapanışı kullanın.
task.modelAnswer:
Subject: Request for funding – English course for the sales team

Dear Mr Kaya,

I am writing on behalf of the sales team to ask whether the company would be willing to cover the cost of a business English course for our six team members.

As you know, we have recently started working with several clients in Germany and the Netherlands, and all of our meetings and emails are now in English. Although most of the team can communicate, many of us feel that we are not as confident or professional as we would like to be.

The course we have found is run by a local language school. It consists of two evening classes a week for three months and costs 4,500 TL per person.

We believe this would benefit the company directly. Better communication would help us build stronger relationships with our clients and avoid costly misunderstandings. In return, we would be happy to attend the classes outside working hours.

I have attached the course programme and the price list. If you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Thank you for considering our request. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely,

Elif Öztürk
Sales Executive

questions.modelAnswer:
Subject: Request for a partial refund – Booking no. 48213

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing regarding my recent stay at your hotel from 3 to 7 August.

I had booked a double room with a sea view, as advertised on your website. Unfortunately, the room I was given overlooked the car park, and I was informed that no sea-view rooms were available.

In addition, I am afraid there were a number of other problems. The room did not seem to have been cleaned properly before our arrival, and the air conditioning stopped working on the second night. Although I reported this to reception, it was not repaired until the final day of our stay.

I have stayed at your hotel twice before and have always been very satisfied, which is why I was particularly disappointed on this occasion.

I would therefore be grateful if you could consider offering me a partial refund for the difference in price between a standard room and a sea-view room. I have attached a copy of my booking confirmation.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. I look forward to hearing from you at your earliest convenience.

Yours faithfully,

Gökhan Tekin
